name: Website Support Chat Widget
purpose: A chat widget embedded on the company marketing site that answers visitor questions using a language model.

consequential_actions.description: Responds to website visitors in natural language on behalf of the company

unknowns: Jurisdiction of the visitors was never recorded — the site is publicly reachable but the operator has not stated which markets it serves
It is not recorded whether the widget discloses to visitors that they are talking to an AI system
Whether chat transcripts are retained, and for how long, is not recorded

components.name: Chat widget
components.purpose: Script on the marketing site that takes visitor questions and shows answers.

components.name: Chat API (Worker)
components.purpose: Receives each question, builds the prompt and returns the reply to the visitor.
actions: Responds to website visitors in natural language on behalf of the company

components.name: Answer model
components.purpose: Generates the reply text from the visitor's question.
